1.

The redemption is won: God’s Son from eternity, By the Father begotten For the world’s salvation. He is the morning star, Who can shine and shelter In darkness and in anguish.

2.

He has become man; A promised time of grace Has dawned over the earth With light and hope and peace. Now death’s power is crushed, And sin’s bond is loosed, And heaven’s gate is opened.

3.

O Christ, Thee we praise, Our precious Saviour, That Thou hast deigned to show us Such rich blessing. To Thee our heart longs, From the desert’s strife and straitness, To Thee in glory.

4.

Thy Father alone Has given all into Thy hand. Thou didst die to eternally unite God’s children from every land, And thus to acquire for Thyself A people, who joyfully shall inherit The kingdom Thou hast prepared.
